universal-everything--ultrasound-vision-.title: Ultrasound VR
universal-everything--ultrasound-vision-.description: An interactive music ecosystem for Apple Vision Pro: by drawing in the space around you, you place audio-reactive sound sculptures and layer them into compositions, with Spatial Audio putting each sound where its sculpture stands.
universal-everything--ultrasound-vision-.description_zh: 一个为 Apple Vision Pro 打造的交互式音乐生态：你在身边的空间里画画，就会放置随音乐律动的声音雕塑，把它们一层层叠加成乐曲；空间音频让每个声音都从对应雕塑所在的位置传来。
universal-everything--ultrasound-vision-.idea_en: Draw in the air to compose music: every stroke becomes a sound sculpture that plays from where you drew it.
universal-everything--ultrasound-vision-.idea_zh: 在空中画画就是在作曲：每一笔都会变成一个声音雕塑，并从你画下它的位置发出声音。
universal-everything--ultrasound-vision-.technique: Hand tracking captures drawing gestures that spawn generative, audio-reactive meshes; each one is bound to a looping sound layer rendered with Spatial Audio at its 3D position, and LiDAR scene understanding lets the sculptures sit on real surfaces.
universal-everything--ultrasound-vision-.technique_zh: 手部追踪捕捉作画手势，生成随音频律动的生成式网格；每个网格都绑定一条循环的声音图层，并用空间音频在它的三维位置播放；LiDAR 场景理解让这些雕塑能贴在真实表面上。
universal-everything--ultrasound-vision-.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or AR Foundation scene where each tap or drawn stroke places a shape that loops one sound sample from its position (use positional audio), so walking around the room remixes the piece. Twist: make each shape's size pulse with its own sound's volume.
universal-everything--ultrasound-vision-.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 AR Foundation 做一个场景：每次点击或画一笔，就在该位置放置一个形体，并从这个位置循环播放一段声音采样（使用空间化音频），让人在房间里走动时就能重新混音；变体：让每个形体的大小随自身声音的音量跳动。
